title: A corner of Chaco
text: By the year 1050, Chaco Canyon was the ceremonial, administrative, and economic center of the San Juan Basin, and a small corner of the park that protects it lies in McKinley County. The Chacoan people's cultural flowering began in the mid 800s and lasted more than 300 years. Chaco is also central to the origins of several Navajo clans.
